content: Ani Pablo, Bab-Dummad-sogedba, Jesucristo-sapin-bur-dummadga-gumogaga anse gorlesad. An gwenad-Sóstenesʼbo bemarse garda narmaksiid.

Bemar-Bab-Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad-Corintoʼgi-danar-bukwad anmar bemarse garda narmaksiid. Bemar, Cristo-Jesúsʼgi-gwage-swilidik gunonimalad. Bab-Dummad e-neggwebur-isligwaledga-guega bemarse gochad. Bela dulemar gwen neg-sukungan-bessuli Bab-Jesucristoʼse-gorbukmaladba-mesa isligwaledga-guega bemarse gochad. A-Jesucristoʼde amar-Dummadga gunonikid, degine, anmar-Dummadga gunonimogad.
Bab-Dummad anmar-baba, degi, Dummad-Jesucristo, bemargi nued binsamarsun, degine, ulubgi-bogidikid bemar-itogega imakbarsun.
Pablo, Bab-Dummadga dog-nuedye sogsad
Bab-Dummad, Cristo-Jesúsʼgi bemargi-ise-nued-binsasadba dog-nuedye gusgu an Bab-Dummadga bemar-nuki sogdaed.
Bemar Jesucristoʼbali bela ibmar-nuegan-burbaled nikunonikid. Bemar yeer-sunmake, degi, ibmar-wisi be gunonimalad.
Degisoggu, Cristoʼgi-Gayaburba-Nued-sunmakleged bemargi oyolenonikid, we-igar, napiragwadye.
Degisoggu, Bab-Dummad-gurgin-burbarmalad-nuegan-ukedi, be galakudeeye binsasurmalad, bela be nikmalad. Unnila anmar-Dummad-Jesucristo-danikoed-e-ibagan-edarbedii be gumarsun.
Bab-Dummaddi mer isguedse be galakuegala, burgwedse be-bendakdii guoed. Adi, anmar-Dummad-Jesucristo-e-danikoed-ibagangi, bega igar-itolealile, ibmar-gwen-oakalossuliyob be daklegegar.
Bab-Dummad e-ibmar-sogsadba na imakedsedasoggu, bemarga e-ibmar-sogsadba na imakodo. Bab-Dummad na e bemarse gochad, adi, E-Machi anmar-Dummad-Jesucristo-walikaa anmar gudii guegar.
Cristoʼba-nanaimalad sordamar-mamarided

Gwenadgan, anmar-Dummad-Jesucristo-nuggi an bemarse nue-wilesakwaa an gorsun. Mer na be akar-akar sunmakmar, bela balibi be-bukwa gumar. Bela be-damaladgi, be-binsamaladgi yopira na be binsabukwa gumar.
Gwenadgan, an weyob bemarga soged, ar ade, Cloé-neg-yaginmalad-anga-sogsadba an bemar-itoged, bemarde na abin-abin imakdimarye.

Ar bemar abar-sogdimalad: “Andi, Pablo-sordaye,” baigandi sogmogad: “Andi, Apolos-sordaye,” degi, baigandi sogdimogad: “Andi, Pedro-sordaye.” Deginbali, abar baigandi sogmogad: “Andi, Cristo-sordaye.”
¿Ar Cristoʼde sordamar-mamaredsi? ¿Ande bemarga nakrusgi burgwissi? Ar bemarde ¿Pablo-nuggi Bab-Dummad-diigi-ogleged-igargi-oglessi? Degisulid.
Bab-diigi-ogleged-igargi an bemar-ogsasurmalad. Agala, Bab-Dummadga dog-nuedye an sogsundo. Unnila Crispo, degi, Gayo, amarbi an Bab-diigi-ogleged-igargi ogsad.
Degisoggu, geg bemar sogmalad: “An Pablo-nuggi Bab-Dummad-diigi-ogleged-igargi oglesye.”
Deginbali, an Estéfanas-neg-yaginmaladbi Bab-diigi-ogleged-igargi an ogsabalid. Baigandi, an insasulid an Bab-diigi-ogleged-igargi ogsabardibe.

Ar ade, Cristo e-diigi-ogleged-igargi dulemar-ogega an-barmissulid. Deginbali, Cristo an-ibmar-wisidba-sunmakedgi an-barmissurbalid. Cristo an-barmialid, Bab-Dummad-Gayaburba-Nuedgi sunmakegar. Ar deyobsulile, Cristo-nakrusgi-burgwisad-e-igar gwen-gangued-nikasuli imaklego-itole.
Bab-ibmar-wisid, degine, e-gangued Cristoʼgi oyolenonikid
Ar dule-yoggus-gudimaladgala, Cristo-nakrusgi-burgwisadgi-sunmakleged-igar, igar-binsaledga gued. Anmar-abonolesmaladgardi, we-Bab-Dummad-Gayaburba-Nuedgi-sunmakleged, Bab-Dummad-e-gangued gued.
Ar Bab-Dummad-Gardagi narmakar naid:
Isaías 29:14

Degite, ¿bia dule-nue-binsaed-ibed nadsunna? ¿Bia Bab-Garda-ogwamalad nadsunna? ¿Bia dule-we-napneggi-igar-dummagan-mamaid-wisimalad nadsunna? Bab-Dummad, ¿we-napneggi-ibmar-wisimalad, ibmar-wissulidyob imaksasursi? Eye, deyob imaksa.
Bab-Dummad, bela e-binsaed-nikadba we-napnegginmaladi dule-binsaedgi, gwen e-amiega imaksasulid. Agala, Bab-Gayaburba-sunmakleged-binsaledga-guedyobidba egi-bensurmalad abonogega imaksad.
Ar Judíoʼmardi ibmar-wilubgan-dakledisurmalad-ega-oyobi abemalad, Griegoʼmardina, ibmar-nue-wisigued amidimalad.
Ar anmardi, Cristo-nakrusgi-burgwisad-igargi sunmakdiid. We-igar, Judíoʼmarga igar-egi-gwisgued gued. Judíoʼsurmaladdi, a-igar, igar-binsaled dakmalad.
Bab-Dummad-dulemarse-gochamaladgardi, Judíoʼmardibe, Griegoʼmardibe, amargardina, Cristo, Bab-Dummad-e-ganguedid, degine, bela e-ibmar-wisid gubalid.
Ar Bab-Dummad-Igar-binsaled-daklegedi, dulemar-e-binsaedba bur binsaed-biriginedid. Degine, Bab-Dummad-ibmar-saed bur nollo-dakle-inigwele, degite, dulemar-ibmar-saedba bur gangued nikad.

Degisoggu gwenadgan, nue na be itomala, Bab-Dummad bese-gochagu, igi be gudimalana. Dulemar sogmalad, bemar-abargi, bemar wis ichee dule-binsaed-ibegan nikmarye, bemar ichee dule-dummagan nikmarbarye, degi, bemar ichee dule-nuga-nikamalad nikamarbarye.
Degi-inigwele, Bab-Dummad we-napneggi dule-ibmar-wissurmaladse gochad, adi, dule-ibmar-nue-wismalad-obingegsaegar. Degine, we-napneggi dule-nollomaladse gochad, adi, dule-nollosurmalad-obingegsaegar.
Bab-Dummad we-napneggi dule-baisur-dakledimalad, degi, dule-isdar-dakledimalad bur susad. Bab-Dummad dule-nug-nikasurmalad susad, adi, nug-nikamalad-osulogegar.
Adi, melle dule Bab-Dummad-asabin na dukin san-odummomalagar.

Ar Bab-Dummad-sunnad Cristo-Jesúsʼgi bemar-oakanonikid. Degi, Cristo anmar-ibmar-nue-wisidga gunonikid. Cristo anmar-isgussulidyob-guedga gunonikid. Cristo anmar-gwage-swilidikga gunonikid. Degi, Cristo anmar-baknonikidga gunonikid.
Adi, Bab-Dummad-Gardagi-narmakar-naidyob guegar:
Jeremías 9:23-24
